description: This PHP class 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroupDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, providing a decorator pattern for the SelectedDisplayFieldGroup entity. It includes methods to encapsulate business logic related to display field groups within the HRM system.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayFieldGroupDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides additional functionality to the SelectedDisplayFieldGroup entity, including setting display field groups by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a SelectedDisplayFieldGroup entity.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldGroupById
methods.description: Sets the associated DisplayFieldGroup for the current SelectedDisplayFieldGroup, identified by its ID.
